newsitem.title: USA: Ohio treasurer authorizes $70 mln of school bonds.
newsitem.headline: Ohio treasurer authorizes $70 mln of school bonds.

text.p: Ohio Treasurer J. Kenneth Blackwell this week approved a negotiated sale of $70 million of elementary and secondary education capital facilities bonds.
Blackwell announced the sale of the series 1997A bonds late Thursday to an underwriting group led by Huntington Capital Corp.
The issue was "warmly received by the market" and sold at a net interest rate of 5.0641 percent and total interest cost of 5.0409 percent, Blackwell announced.
The bonds were rated Aa3 by Moody's Investors Service Inc., AA-minus by Standard & Poor's Ratings Services and AA-minus by Fitch.
